events.headline: UKRAINE TARGETS RUSSIAN OIL DEPOTS AND TANKERS IN DRONE ATTACKS
events.detail: Ukraine hit two oil tankers in Sea of Azov and several oil facilities across Russia in drone attacks.

events.headline: DEADLY US STRIKES TRIGGER IRANIAN ATTACKS ON GULF STATES
events.detail: The US military says it has struck 90 targets in Iran. Iran says it sent drone strikes on US-linked sites in the Gulf.
